cross_region_correlations: Luminosity, radiative correction and efficiency uncertainties are shared between regions. No cross-region covariance is invented.
cross_section_definition: Published Born cross sections; no additional undressing or final-state-radiation conversion performed.

high_energy.errors: First statistical, second total systematic. No high-energy covariance is supplied here. For its a_mu integral over 1.1-2.0 GeV, the paper conservatively treats systematics as 100% correlated; this is not imposed on the full table.
high_energy.nonresonant_bins: 3.0-3.1 and 3.1-3.2 GeV have J/psi contribution subtracted.

low_energy.correlated_systematic: Second printed error retained as a vector; includes luminosity, radiative correction, efficiency and unfolding. No rank-one covariance or independent-bin approximation imposed.
low_energy.covariance_order: rows/columns ordered by increasing mass, identical to below_1p1.csv
low_energy.residual_systematic: Third printed error: background subtraction and Lorentzian/Gaussian resolution uncertainties; use supplied covariance.

method: Parse original source Tables IV/V; retain all published error components separately.
